items.title: George Shearing interviewed by Joe Williams, New York City, New York, March 8, 1996
items.q: The interviewee only confirms the name 'Armando Peraza' after the interviewer mentions McKibbon in the context of Cal Tjader's band. No direct interaction or relationship between George Shearing and McKibbon is stated.

ctx.x: I love it. Two, eleven — Oh my God. That’s beautiful. It did get a little out there. Dizzy Gillespie and the fellas kind of upset up.

Oh he was very authentic. Dizzy. Well Chano Pozo, you know, and that’s where McKibbon learned all that stuff, from Chano Pozo. And then of course McKibbon came with me, and Tjader, Cal Tjader. And then Armando.
